activation.title: Upgrade to Tianshu Pro
activation.subtitle: Enter a Pro license code to unlock Computer Use, team max, multi-round council, and other advanced features. Core features stay free.
activation.graceNotice: Offline grace period active — reconnect before {{date}} to keep Pro.
activation.revoked: The Pro license is no longer valid ({{reason}}). The app has returned to Basic; enter a new license code to unlock again.
activation.success: Pro unlocked. Restarting the app to apply…

errors.code_revoked: This activation code has been revoked.
errors.activation_limit_reached: This code has reached its device limit.
errors.trial_already_used: This device has already used a trial license. Please upgrade to Pro.
errors.device_mismatch: The token does not match this device.
errors.no_token: The server did not return a valid token.
errors.network: Could not reach the license server. Check your connection and try again.

banner.sidecarGaveUp: The runtime process crashed repeatedly in a short period, so auto-restart has stopped. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, check disk space and the data directory (Settings → Storage), or check the logs and report the issue.
banner.sidecarFailed: Sidecar failed to start: no Node runtime found or the port is in use. Please restart the app; if it still fails, check your installation.
banner.needsSetup: No model provider API key is configured — conversations and sub-agent delegation are unavailable.
banner.pythonMissing: Python not detected. Install Python before running Python scripts or projects.
banner.pythonHintWin: Windows: install Python 3.12 from the Microsoft Store
banner.pythonHintLinux: Linux: sudo apt install python3 python3-pip
banner.autocrlf: Line-ending settings may affect code diffs. Your Git currently converts files to Windows line endings (CRLF), but the AI writes Unix line endings (LF), which makes diffs show whole-file changes (line-ending differences only).
banner.gitMissing: Git not detected. Repository operations require Git.
banner.gitHintMac: macOS: xcode-select --install or brew install git
banner.gitBashMissing: Git Bash not detected. The current shell falls back to {{shell}}; some bash commands may be incompatible.

toast.runtimeRestoredNoKey: Runtime recovered, but no usable API key was detected (environment variables may have been lost on restart). Please reconfigure your key in Settings.
toast.autocrlfFixed: Fixed — Git line endings set to input (keep LF)
